text: AI agents can write code and move money. But a payment rail cannot tell whether an offchain pull request truly met its scope.
ScopeSettle locks the rubric, weights, provider, budget, expiry, and confidence threshold before funding an ERC-8183 escrow on X Layer.
For this public Testnet job, the deliverable is pinned to one GitHub pull request and one immutable head commit. No moving branch can change the evidence.
Deterministic checks verify repository identity, required files, diff bounds, and CI. The hosted evaluator then scores only cited evidence against the immutable rubric.
The manifest criterion scored one hundred, but the required lockfile criterion scored zero because pinned CI was failing. Weighted score: fifty.
That uncertainty did not trigger an automatic payout. It routed to the named trusted reviewer, who rejected the verdict and refunded the full valueless Testnet escrow.
The commerce and evaluator contracts are also source-verified on X Layer Mainnet with native USDC. No Mainnet job or user adoption is claimed.
Every report, hash, receipt, limitation, and test is public. ScopeSettle: verified work, automatic settlement.
